This is a **lower bound** — static analysis only, not execution. Fields accessed via computed/bracket keys, or copied into other tables before use, won't show up in `response_fields`.

Not implemented in `game_logic.py` yet unless noted elsewhere in `PROTOCOL_NOTES.md`. Use this to look up what a given MID's request/response shape needs to be, once you see it show up as `no handler for mid=...` in the server log.
